context: A grandmother and granddaughter discuss morning habits
purpose: Teach: 確認する/検診/寒い/笑顔/寝室/朝食/翌朝/起き上がる

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: さくら、今日は早いって聞いたから、寝室のドアを少し開けておいたよ。
lines.en: Sakura, I heard today is an early start, so I left the bedroom door open a little.
lines.style: Warm, grandmotherly tone with gentle concern and a slow, caring pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう、おばあちゃん。今朝は寒いから、布団から起き上がるのが大変だったよ。
lines.en: Thanks, Grandma. It's cold this morning, so getting up out of the futon was tough.
lines.style: Bright teenage voice, casual and a bit sleepy in the early morning.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そうだろうねえ。だからおばあちゃん、もう朝食の準備をしておいたんだよ。
lines.en: I figured as much. That's why Grandma already got breakfast ready for you.
lines.style: Soft, doting delivery with a small chuckle at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わあ、思わず笑顔になっちゃう。やっぱりおばあちゃんの味噌汁が一番だよ。
lines.en: Wow, I can't help but smile. Grandma's miso soup really is the best.
lines.style: Excited and affectionate teen, with a small giggle of joy.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ふふ、ところでさくら、来週の健康検診の予定、ちゃんと確認するのを忘れないでね。
lines.en: Hehe, by the way Sakura, don't forget to check your schedule for next week's health checkup.
lines.style: Caring matronly reminder, gentle but firm and clear at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あっ、そうだった。今夜カレンダーで確認するね。学校から書類もらってきたよ。
lines.en: Oh, that's right. I'll check it on the calendar tonight. I got the paperwork from school.
lines.style: Quick, apologetic teen tone, then perking up with cheerful reassurance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: えらいねえ。翌朝早く出るなら、今夜は早めに寝るんだよ。
lines.en: Good girl. If you're leaving early the next morning, go to bed early tonight.
lines.style: Gentle praise followed by a soft, motherly instruction, warm and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、いただきます！おばあちゃんと食べる朝ごはん、毎日楽しみなんだよ。
lines.en: Yes, thanks for the food! Eating breakfast with you is something I look forward to every day.
lines.style: Cheerful and heartfelt teen voice, sincere and a little emotional.
